Check.description: Normalized synthetic observation; true is adverse, false clear only when available. Unknown is unavailable; skipped is unfetched. Failed/skipped timestamp zero values are absence sentinels. Optional event_time, subject and scope describe existing Go output.

Evaluation.description: Completed traces are immutable. execution_unconfirmed retains journal and null aggregate costs/elapsed_ms; null is uncertainty, not zero. starting is an uncertain intention, completed records an observed result. See POLICY.md.

seed.description: Omitted/zero defaults to 42; nonzero signed int64 accepted.

TenantRole.description: Assignable tenant roles; platform_operator is reserved for provisioning CLI.
